entry_case: User-selected Sep 11 signal example, enter Sep 12 09:00 KST. Not a whole-month detector backtest.
partial_exit: Prior study C: running high reaches +12%, then completed 5m close at or below 95% of running high; use next actual 5m open.
remaining_exit: Prior study A: at least two of MACD histogram, RSI14, Williams14 daily first differences are negative; use next actual 5m open after daily close.
priority: If A occurs before or simultaneously with C, liquidate the full remaining quantity under A. Otherwise C sells half once, then A sells the remaining half.
study_endpoint: Same five-day window as the prior study; report any endpoint exit separately from a signal exit.
quantity_rounding: Fractional quantity without exchange size rounding; illustrative cash ledger, no historical order-book reconstruction.
interpretation: Chosen after reviewing the prior ARK and ten-case results. Illustrative combination, not independent validation or fitted high-price execution. No runtime changes.
